rule: AGENTS.md theorem-writing policy: state an enforceable condition package whose conclusion matches Hansen; assumptions must make the claimed mathematical role explicit
claim: The triangular certificate did not require the limit selector value to minimize the limiting generalized Rayleigh quotient, so the endpoint identified only an arbitrary continuous selector image rather than Hansen's mu*.
evidence: Hansen defines mu* as the minimum of the full reduced-form generalized Rayleigh quotient. The certificate originally required only finite-sample minimization.
suggested_fix: Add a limiting Rayleigh-minimizer obligation and expose that characterization with the CMT conclusion.
